name: BLX-α with α = 0
lesson: With α = 0 the children of BLX-α stay inside the box spanned by their parents, so without mutation the search cannot expand.
lookFor: Mutation is off. On the four-optima landscape the box around the population never grows, and with this seed Run until stop pauses at generation 79 for stagnation with the best so far −9.94 (f = 9.94), not within ε = 0.89 of any optimum. The next preset runs the same seed with α = 0.5. With seeds 1 to 100, 37 runs reach ε with α = 0 against 66 with α = 0.5.
